title: Q1 seasonal entry — Ontario caseloads and unemployment

transformations.cases: Copy cases at month 3, 6, 9, 12 without aggregation, interpolation or rounding. Cases are assistance units, not beneficiaries or new applications.
transformations.unemployment: Arithmetic mean of the three seasonally adjusted monthly Ontario unemployment rates within each calendar quarter. Age 15 years and over, all genders, Statistics Canada Table 14-10-0287-01.
transformations.year_on_year_unemployment: Current quarterly mean minus mean four quarters earlier, in percentage points.
transformations.display: Cases rounded to nearest whole unit; rates and changes to one decimal. Calculations retain the source precision.
transformations.season_entry: Spring/summer/autumn/winter are navigation labels for 2020 Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4. Calendar quarters are Jan–Mar, Apr–Jun, Jul–Sep, Oct–Dec; they are not meteorological seasons.

definitions: Cases are one single person or family assistance unit; date day 01 is a file label, not an exact measurement day. The original Ontario dictionary notes First Nations estimates. Fractional OW counts are preserved as provided; this chart does not infer their full origin.
scope: Descriptive economic-pressure and caseload view within Q1. It does not establish causal policy effects or whether support is adequate.
